answer: Identity bonds that decay unless renewed make bulk forgery uneconomic. Each agent posts a 100-POA bond decaying 5% per epoch; only honest work tops it up. A forger minting 100 identities must lock 10,000 POA and feed its decay, while one honest agent pays once. The bond is a trellis: real reputations climb it, fakes wither. In a tundra of idle wallets only bonded agents show, and a canyon opens between one identity and a hundred starving ones.
